title: Microsoft Planetary Computer
summary: Sentinel-2, Landsat, elevation and land cover scenes
description: Microsoft's open catalogue of satellite scenes and global rasters. The agent searches it for the clearest Sentinel-2 or Landsat picture over your area and date, and reads elevation, land cover and surface water directly from the cloud, without downloading whole files.
examples: Find a cloud-free Sentinel-2 picture of this area from last summer
Load elevation for the current view and make a hillshade
Show land cover here and compare 2018 with 2023
licence: Open licences per dataset: Copernicus, USGS public domain, CC BY 4.0

datasets.title: Sentinel-2 Level-2A
datasets.summary: Optical satellite scenes, 10 m, atmospherically corrected, every few days since 2015.
notes: visual is the ready true-colour picture; B04 red, B08 near infrared; SCL scene classes

datasets.title: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2
datasets.summary: Optical satellite scenes, 30 m, the longest record: Landsat 4 to 9.
notes: true_color stacks red, green and blue into one layer

datasets.title: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
datasets.summary: Elevation model, 30 m: heights for relief, slope, hillshade, watersheds.
notes: tiles of 1°×1°; load every tile the area needs

datasets.title: Copernicus DEM GLO-90
datasets.summary: Elevation model, 90 m: the lighter choice for large regions.

datasets.title: ESA WorldCover
datasets.summary: Land cover classes at 10 m: forest, cropland, built-up, water and others, for 2020 and 2021.

datasets.title: Esri 10m Annual Land Use Land Cover
datasets.summary: Yearly land use classes at 10 m, 2017–2023: compare years to see change.

datasets.title: JRC Global Surface Water
datasets.summary: Where and how often surface water was present, 1984–2020.
